ansatz: u=u0(x)+t*MLP(sin(x),cos(x),t/end)[:3]; p=MLP[...,3]. Exact initial velocity and periodic inputs. No exact transient velocity labels.
loss: Mean squared continuity plus sum of three mean squared momentum residuals, equally weighted, no adaptive weighting.
scope: Integration pilot before a preregistered spatial/temporal sampling matrix. Not a convergence or acceptance claim.
